mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, content, record_type, core_question, status, unlock_at, sealed_at, unlocked_at, draft_expires_at, ai_summary, ai_prompt_result, belief_then, reality_later, reality_later_submit_count, life_node_type, life_node_custom_label, cover_attachment_id, agent_memory_excluded, agent_memory_context_note, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `record` ( user_id, title, content, record_type, core_question, status, unlock_at, sealed_at, unlocked_at, draft_expires_at, ai_summary, ai_prompt_result, belief_then, reality_later, reality_later_submit_count, life_node_type, life_node_custom_label, cover_attachment_id, agent_memory_excluded, agent_memory_context_note, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{recordType}, #{coreQuestion}, #{status}, #{unlockAt}, #{sealedAt}, #{unlockedAt}, #{draftExpiresAt}, #{aiSummary}, #{aiPromptResult}, #{beliefThen}, #{realityLater}, COALESCE(#{realityLaterSubmitCount}, 0), #{lifeNodeType}, #{lifeNodeCustomLabel}, #{coverAttachmentId}, #{agentMemoryExcluded}, #{agentMemoryContextNote}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `record` WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM `record` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `record` WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `record` SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, record_type = #{recordType}, core_question = #{coreQuestion}, ai_summary = #{aiSummary}, ai_prompt_result = #{aiPromptResult}, belief_then = #{beliefThen}, life_node_type = #{lifeNodeType}, life_node_custom_label = #{lifeNodeCustomLabel}, unlock_at = #{unlockAt}, draft_expires_at = CASE WHEN status = 'DRAFT' THEN #{draftExpiresAt} ELSE NULL END, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'SAVED') AND (status = 'SAVED' OR draft_expires_at > #{updatedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM `record` WHERE status = 'SEALED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM data_operation_record i JOIN data_operation o ON o.id=i.operation_id WHERE i.record_id=`record`.id AND i.item_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED') AND o.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED') ) AND unlock_at IS NOT NULL AND unlock_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM `record` WHERE status = 'DRAFT' AND draft_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND draft_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY draft_expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE `record` SET status = 'UNLOCKED', unlocked_at = #{unlockedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SEALED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM data_operation_record i JOIN data_operation o ON o.id=i.operation_id WHERE i.record_id=`record`.id AND i.item_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED') AND o.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_REQUIRED') )
